definitions.text_mt: Ġennien: persuna li tieħu ħsieb il-ġonna u l-pjanti

usage_examples.maltese: Il-ġennien jieħu ħsieb il-ward fil-ġnien.
usage_examples.english: The gardener tends the roses in the garden.

usage_examples.maltese: Il-ġennien qala' l-ħaxix mill-art.
usage_examples.english: The gardener picked the vegetables from the ground.

definitions.text_mt: Ġenoċida: li għandu x'jaqsam mal-ġenoċidju jew li jwettaq ġenoċidju
Ġenoċidju: il-qtil ta' massa ta' nies, speċjalment grupp etniku jew nazzjonali

usage_examples.maltese: Il-ġenoċidju huwa wieħed mill-agħar reati kontra l-umanità.
usage_examples.english: Genocide is one of the worst crimes against humanity.

usage_examples.maltese: Il-qorti kkundannat lil dawk responsabbli għall-ġenoċidju.
usage_examples.english: The court convicted those responsible for the genocide.

definitions.text_en: society (people of one’s country or community as a whole)
definitions.text_mt: Ġens: is-soċjetà ta' pajjiż jew komunità

usage_examples.maltese: Il-ġens Malti għandu storja twila ta' kultura u tradizzjonijiet.
usage_examples.english: The Maltese people have a long history of culture and traditions.

usage_examples.maltese: Il-ġens jista' jkun maskili jew femminili.
usage_examples.english: Gender can be masculine or feminine.

usage_examples.maltese: Il-ġens huwa l-ogħla rank fil-klassifikazzjoni tassonomika.
usage_examples.english: The genus is the highest rank in taxonomic classification.

definitions.text_mt: Ġeografija: l-istudju xjentifiku tal-art, il-karatteristiċi naturali, u l-fenomeni tad-dinja

usage_examples.maltese: Il-ġeografija tistudja l-muntanji, ix-xmajjar u l-ibħra.
usage_examples.english: Geography studies mountains, rivers and seas.

usage_examples.maltese: It-tifel tiegħi qed jitgħallem il-ġeografija fl-iskola.
usage_examples.english: My son is learning geography at school.

usage_examples.maltese: Ġeografikament, Malta tinsab fin-nofs tal-Baħar Mediterran.
usage_examples.english: Geographically, Malta is located in the middle of the Mediterranean Sea.

usage_examples.maltese: Il-pożizzjoni ġeografika ta' Malta hija strateġika.
usage_examples.english: Malta's geographic position is strategic.

usage_examples.maltese: Il-ġeografu ppublika mappa ġdida tar-reġjun.
usage_examples.english: The geographer published a new map of the region.

usage_examples.maltese: Ħafna ġeografi jistudjaw l-effetti tat-tibdil fil-klima.
usage_examples.english: Many geographers study the effects of climate change.

definitions.text_mt: Ġeometra: persuna li tkejjel l-art, speċjalment għall-kostruzzjoni

usage_examples.maltese: Il-ġeometra kejjel l-art għall-bini l-ġdid.
usage_examples.english: The surveyor measured the land for the new building.

definitions.text_mt: Ġeometrija: il-fergħa tal-matematika li tistudja l-proprjetajiet u r-relazzjonijiet tal-punti, il-linji, l-uċuħ u s-solidi

usage_examples.maltese: Il-ġeometrija hija waħda mill-eqdem fergħat tal-matematika.
usage_examples.english: Geometry is one of the oldest branches of mathematics.

usage_examples.maltese: It-tfal jitgħallmu l-ġeometrija bażika fl-iskola primarja.
usage_examples.english: Children learn basic geometry in primary school.

usage_examples.maltese: Il-kwadru huwa forma ġeometrikament perfetta.
usage_examples.english: The square is a geometrically perfect shape.

usage_examples.maltese: It-tpinġija turi forom ġeometriċi bħal ċrieki u trijangoli.
usage_examples.english: The drawing shows geometric shapes like circles and triangles.

usage_examples.maltese: Il-ġeometru uża formula biex ikkalkula l-erja taċ-ċirku.
usage_examples.english: The geometer used a formula to calculate the area of the circle.

usage_examples.maltese: It-tifel ġera malajr lejn l-iskola.
usage_examples.english: The boy ran quickly towards school.

usage_examples.maltese: L-ilma ġera mill-vit bis-sħiħ.
usage_examples.english: The water flowed from the tap at full force.

usage_examples.maltese: X'ġara lbieraħ fil-laqgħa?
usage_examples.english: What happened yesterday at the meeting?

definitions.text_mt: Ġeraħ: iddannja b'mod serju u bid-demm

usage_examples.maltese: Il-ġellied ġeraħ lil sieħbu bis-sejf.
usage_examples.english: The fighter wounded his companion with the sword.

usage_examples.maltese: Huwa ġeraħ idejh waqt li kien jaħdem mal-ħġieġ.
usage_examples.english: He injured his hand while working with glass.

definitions.text_mt: Ġergħa: l-ammont ta' likwidu li jinbela' f'daqqa

usage_examples.maltese: Xrob l-ilma b'ġergħa waħda.
usage_examples.english: I drank the water in one gulp.

usage_examples.maltese: Ġergħa ilma kiesħa kienet biżżejjed biex tirkupra.
usage_examples.english: A gulp of cold water was enough to recover.

definitions.text_mt: Ġermaniż: relatat mal-Ġermanja, il-poplu Ġermaniż, jew il-lingwa Ġermaniża

usage_examples.maltese: Il-karozzi Ġermaniżi huma magħrufa għall-kwalità tagħhom.
usage_examples.english: German cars are known for their quality.

definitions.text_mt: Ġermaniż: il-lingwa Ġermaniża, il-lingwa uffiċjali tal-Ġermanja

usage_examples.maltese: Il-Ġermaniżi huma magħrufa għall-puntwalità tagħhom.
usage_examples.english: Germans are known for their punctuality.

usage_examples.maltese: Il-Ġermaniż huwa l-lingwa uffiċjali tal-Ġermanja, tal-Awstrija u tal-Iżvizzera.
usage_examples.english: German is the official language of Germany, Austria and Switzerland.

definitions.text_mt: Ġermaniża: il-forma femminili ta' Ġermaniż, relatata mal-Ġermanja

usage_examples.maltese: Il-kultura Ġermaniża hija sinjura fl-istorja.
usage_examples.english: German culture is rich in history.

usage_examples.maltese: Iltaqa' ma' Ġermaniża waqt il-vaganza tiegħu.
usage_examples.english: He met a German woman during his holiday.

etymology_chain.definition: Germany (a country in Central Europe; official name: Repubblica Federale Tedesca )

usage_examples.maltese: Il-Ġermanja hija l-ikbar ekonomija fl-Ewropa.
usage_examples.english: Germany is the largest economy in Europe.

usage_examples.maltese: Żort Berlin, il-kapitali tal-Ġermanja, is-sena l-oħra.
usage_examples.english: I visited Berlin, the capital of Germany, last year.

definitions.text_mt: Ġermanju: element kimiku, simbolu Ge, b'numru atomiku 32

usage_examples.maltese: Il-ġermanju jintuża fil-manifattura ta' transisters.
usage_examples.english: Germanium is used in the manufacture of transistors.

definitions.text_mt: Ġerra: ġiegħel lil xi ħadd jiġri

usage_examples.maltese: Il-bidwi ġerra ż-żiemel madwar ir-razzett.
usage_examples.english: The farmer made the horse run around the farm.

usage_examples.maltese: Huwa ġerra l-karozza tiegħu tul l-awtostrada.
usage_examples.english: He drove his car fast along the motorway.

definitions.text_en: to bear, to tolerate, to stand

usage_examples.maltese: Wara l-ikel, huwa ġerragħ kollox sew.
usage_examples.english: After the meal, he digested everything well.

usage_examples.maltese: Ma nistax niġerragħ iktar din l-umiljazzjoni.
usage_examples.english: I cannot bear this humiliation any longer.
